Combine retro trend with modern LED technology! The Deco Retro Blinder is a unique and stylish LED effect that can emit very warm, vintage-coloured light via its 3x 30W High power LEDs, as well as RGB-coloured effects via the additional 72x SMD LEDs located around the perimeter of its highly reflective aluminium inner housing. Each of its amber coloured COB LEDs can be independently controlled via DMX as a strobe effect with full RGB colour mix. This dual retro effect creates vibrant lighting with several spectacular visual effects.
